_comment: Epic 1 (Measurement Validation Gate) — IDLE workload. Pixel 9 over WiFi-ADB at 192.168.178.47:5555 (alias 'Pixel 9-W'). NO usb_handler block — the hub adapter died (12V/500mA router brick on a 12V/4A+ load) so the hub is currently unpowered, but Pixel 9 is already physically disconnected from USB and discharging at ~215 mA, exactly the state Epic 1.6 was designed to create programmatically. APK installed = Calculator (placeholder; doesn't drive the workload). Interaction = sleep for 60s (no input). BatteryManager samples current_now/voltage every 100 ms throughout. Companion: validation_cpu_pixel9_wifi.json. Run command (from android-runner/ with venv active): python3 . examples/batterymanager/validation_idle_pixel9_wifi.json
